ITEM 1 | Diced cooked white meat in cubes about 1.5-2 cm, pale cream-white with light golden edges and slightly fibrous surface, dry-looking with no visible sauce, piled in a heap in the upper-center of a stainless steel bowl about 15 cm across | 150
ITEM 2 | Whole cherry tomatoes, bright red with glossy skins, about 2-3 cm diameter, scattered in the lower-left and lower-center of the bowl, some partly hidden under the diced white pieces | 110
ITEM 3 | Green bell pepper strips, bright green with slightly translucent edges, cut into thin strips about 4-5 cm long and 0.5 cm wide, lying among the tomatoes and under the meat | 40
ITEM 4 | Shredded orange carrot, fine thin matchstick strands about 3-4 cm long, bright orange, scattered loosely across the bottom of the bowl among the peppers and tomatoes | 15
ITEM 5 | Red bell pepper pieces, small irregular chunks, deep red with slight sheen, partially visible in the lower center of the bowl beside the tomatoes | 15
